description.value: Blend Bubble Tea is a community fixture in Port Coquitlam, crafting modern bubble tea using traditional cooking methods and offering signature drinks like Brown Sugar Milk Tea alongside Bao Bites and hot foods. The shop also sells DIY Bubble Tea Kits and branded merchandise, and operates a mobile catering service that has served events ranging from intimate gatherings to 16,000-person conventions. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a broad menu of cold and hot drinks plus light food options in a welcoming neighborhood setting.
